headline: Khloe Kardashian has answered online critics of her family's AI-made TV sketch by telling them to watch the whole clip.
score_reason: Pool 2 kept: a light entertainment follow-up from one outlet, with no wider consequence.
importance_line: It shows how a sketch meant as a stand against AI still drew criticism from some viewers because it used AI, which touches mostly fans of the show, and it rests on one outlet's account and two unnamed social-media comments.
summary: UNILAD reports that Khloe Kardashian has replied to online critics of the AI-made sketch that opens season eight of The Kardashians on Hulu, posting the clip on Instagram with the words "WATCH UNTIL THE END" and saying people comment after seeing only the first seconds. She is answering the criticism of the sketch we covered in our 9 Oct 2026 edition, when Vulture reported that the premiere opens with AI-generated copies of the family that glitch (one grows a tail) until the real family steps in.
notes: Reply story: Khloe Kardashian answers unnamed online critics; the earlier story is Vulture's report in our 9 Oct 2026 edition (item 105). The date of her Instagram post is not stated.
